description: Update the content, title, folder, or source of an existing knowledge base entry.

entryId.description: Unique identifier of the entry to update

expiresAt.description: When the entry stops being true (ISO 8601 with offset, e.g. 2026-10-16T23:59:59+05:00). The bot ignores it afterwards and it is deleted within the hour. Null clears it.

kbId.description: Unique identifier of the knowledge base

source.description: New source type for the entry

name: neuron_update_kb_entry
title: Update Knowledge Base Entry
